predecessors.name: Jin dynasty (Western and Eastern Jin)
predecessors.text: Liyang and Huatai ('in modern Anyang, Henan', Zhai Liao page): Zhai Liao took Liyang in 386 and made Huatai his capital in 388; drawn as a 55 km disc round Hua County

successors.name: Later Yan
successors.text: Liyang, Huatai and Yingyang Commandery: the commanderies the pages name for Zhai Wei

ledger.x: 388: Zhai Liao takes the title of Heavenly King and moves to Huatai.
389: Zhai Wei takes Yingyang from Jin.

wars.name: Zhai Liao's war against Later Yan
wars.outcome: Zhai Liao was beaten in late 384, forced to submit in 387, rebelled again in winter 387 and was crushed by Murong Chui in 392 at Liyang.

wars.name: Jin campaign against Zhai Wei
wars.outcome: Zhai Liao took Yingyang in 389 and failed to take Luoyang in 390; the Jin general Liu Laozhi 'captured Juancheng and defeated Zhai Liao near Huatai' in autumn 390 without destroying the state.

certainty.note: A four-year warlord kingdom: commanderies named, no boundary on any page.
